readme: Dated reproduction record. Create root/source at the recorded commit; build FFTW in root/fftw-neon with the recorded configure flags; create root/harness/CMakeLists.txt from harness_cmake and apply harness_patch to source/tests/native/callback_benchmark.cpp as root/harness/callback_backend.cpp. Configure root/accelerate and root/fftw from harness with Release, CONVOLVER_BUILD_TESTS=ON and the respective CONVOLVER_FFT_BACKEND; supply the FFTW installation and libsndfile prefix in CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH. Build convolver_backend_benchmark, convolver_cli, convolver_engine_tests, convolver_fft_tests. Run both oracles. Generate root/patient.fftw with the recorded tuning command, then run the sibling dated -run.py script with root as its argument. Local paths in captured command output identify this run; substitute your root when reproducing.
